steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Whoa... So this is the famous must-see spot that every Sinner has to visit—the Interrogation Room?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: The lighting really sets the mood! These instruments are actually monitoring my vitals, huh. This chair... did you really install these screws yourself, Chief?
The interrogation room is dimly lit, with a table separating the two of you.
Sitting in her chair and swinging her legs, the young Sinner girl named Poffy looks around in all directions with curiosity.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: This table is so cool! It feels like we could shoot a spy movie here! Oh, a camera! Can Sinners stream from here too?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Hello there! I'm going on camera now!
This should be the time to set aside the day's exhaustion and enjoy a peaceful dinner, yet here you are dealing with the Bureau's newest member and her relentless barrage of questions.
You open Poffy's file with a resigned sigh.
[Black Screen Transition]
Five days ago, the Bureau received an anonymous tip.

The letter was short and simple. Rumors have been circulating online that a lurking glutton has been snatching food from passersby near the entrance to Eastside's street food market, and the suspect is believed to be a Sinner. This lurking glutton is allegedly a mukbang streamer and none other than Poffy the glutton.

After verifying the information, the Bureau's staff quickly obtained her residential address. When they arrived at her door, she showed no intention of fleeing. Instead, she had already packed her bags and was waiting at the entrance.

Such an enthusiastic welcome was certainly a first. As you stood there holding up your identification in bewilderment, a head wearing a brown hat poked out from the living room. You've stumbled upon an old acquaintance.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Oh my, Chief! You're here too? What a coincidence! This girl here is one of my clients. I had no idea she was a Sinner!

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: You need her to cooperate with the investigation, right? No problem at all! I already told her the Bureau has great food, and the Chief there is a wonderful person. She can totally settle in there without any worries.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Back in the Bureau, don't you guys always say that better care for Sinners starts with all of us? She only likes eating a little too much. No need to be so hard on her, okay?
Luminita rattled off a bunch of sentences, leaving you no chance to interrupt. Then she turned to pat Poffy's shoulder, offering earnest advice.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Though you're going to the Bureau, rent for this unit is paid annually and non-refundable! But... given that we've had a Sinner in this apartment, I can try to ask the landlord for a discount on the rent next year!
At the time, you didn't think too hard about it, simply focusing on bringing the cooperative Sinner back to the Bureau. Now it seems like you might be the one who got played?
[Black Screen Transition]
Five days later, Nightingale stood in the Chief's office, looking utterly helpless for the first time.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, Sinner Poffy's Emotion Test results came back normal. Her stats are at a stable, above-average level. Her social skills, cognitive function, and values all meet our standards for an ordinary person.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Over these five days, she's spent most of her time in the Bureau's cafeteria, sometimes even helping the staff with cooking. She's earned unanimous praise from the kitchen crew.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She posts photos on social media every day with titles like What I Was Fed Today. The posts are getting a lot of traction, and now her fans are extremely interested in what meals the Bureau serves every day.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She's also getting along very well with people in the Bureau. She's already given Wynn fashion advice, discussed trendy new restaurants with Ignis, and submitted twenty-six suggestions to the cafeteria.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Doesn't sound like there are any issues? She's lively, cheerful, and gets along well with everyone she meets.
Then Nightingale reluctantly handed you a document, her expression troubled.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The logistics department just filed a formal complaint. According to the statistics, the Bureau's food reserves have decreased by... 37%. At this rate, our quarterly food budget will be exceeded in another two weeks.
[Black Screen Transition]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Having a big appetite isn't a bad thing, but eating the Bureau out of house and home definitely is...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't tell me she voluntarily came to the Bureau just to freeload meals...
The girl sitting across from you beams with a bright smile, her fingers twining together slightly nervously. It's nearly impossible to harbor any suspicion toward that innocent face.

You shake your head, pushing that ridiculous guess out of your mind. Several faces flash across your mind. Every single Sinner who turned themselves in to the Bureau before her has been nothing but trouble. You can't let her appearance fool you!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you know why you were brought here?
Poffy nods earnestly.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Of course I know! Otherwise I wouldn't have come along so willingly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This interview should have taken place on your first day at the Bureau, but given your voluntary cooperation and the special circumstances, we're only starting today.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Most people would run at the sight of a Bureau agent, not pack their bags and wait at the door. Did you get tipped off, or did Luminita tell you something?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Oh goodness... I'm just a small-time food streamer. How would I know anything about the Bureau? Actually... even if you hadn't come that day, I would have turned myself in anyway!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Luminita should have told you that Sinners here don't have the same freedom as ordinary people. Even knowing that, you still chose to come. Why?
Poffy is clearly a little flustered by your serious grilling, though she manages to maintain her smile.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Because... because my ability is just too terrifying! If you don't keep me contained and just let me live freely out there, it'll definitely make a disaster!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Like snatching someone's fried chicken drumstick at Eastside's busiest food market?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Oh, that drumstick smelled sooo good! Made me feel like someone was having a percussion session with chicken drumsticks inside my head. I was so hungry I was about to lose my mind... I just couldn't resist!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Quite a creative metaphor...
You study the girl smiling sweetly across from you, trying to read into her expression, but quickly give up. She seems genuine and friendly enough. No wonder everyone at the Bureau likes her.

But you still believe that as a food streamer who's signed with MCN, Poffy should be able to support herself financially. Her voluntary arrival at the Bureau and ready confession to her crimes suggest her motives go deeper than simply mooching for free meals.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've encountered many Sinners—more than your age in years. Among them, quite a few indeed possess abilities that are truly terrifying.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Compared to them, or at least the vast majority of them, your special power and the impact you can cause are relatively mild. It's nothing worthy of concern.
You slide her file forward, where Danger Assessment: A-Class is clearly written. Feeling her abilities questioned, Poffy puffs out her cheeks in indignation.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Hey, don't say that! I... I can be really scary when I'm hungry!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I'd lurk around like a starving ghost. Whether it's a steamed bun in a homeless man's hand or a snack a child's munching on, no food can escape my clutches! I'll even charge into bakeries and devour every cookie the staff just finished baking...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Simply put... I'm a potentially dangerous Sinner you should not overlook! If you don't detain me today, tomorrow's headline is gonna be Girl Devours City's Last Bowl of Rice!
You can't help but laugh at Poffy's exaggerated threats, shrugging dismissively.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Honestly, a charge like snatching snacks from people at the street food market... no one would've even bothered to arrest you if it hadn't been for the report.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If I saw a girl so hungry she was seeing stars, I'd offer her food myself.
Poffy is completely stunned. She stares at you blankly, her cheeks flushing bright red.
Her lips move slightly. Just when you expect her to muster the courage to continue arguing, her defiant spirit suddenly deflates.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Can we take a little break? We've been talking for a while and I'm getting hungry... Um, am I allowed to eat here?
Now it's your turn to be stunned.
You were prepared for another round of verbal sparring, but now you're forced to call a halt. If what she said is true, that hunger makes her go insane, then...

options: No food or drink in the interrogation room.

choices.text: No food or drink in the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Are you serious?! Is the Bureau really that strict?
Poffy's face falls. She fidgets anxiously, picking and scratching at things as she tries to cope with her hunger-induced anxiety.
You watch her every move closely, maintaining your stern expression as you continue questioning.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are there any other harmful effects of your special power? Scaring people by stealing their food alone isn't grounds for long-term detention.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I can eat thirty rice balls in one sitting!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...That's only a threat to your wallet, not to anyone else. You're still young, but you should watch out for diabetes.
You let out a sigh and make a show of closing your notebook, preparing to stand up and end today's interrogation.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: We... we're not done yet! I've done quite a few bad things! I just... haven't told you everything! What if you let me out and my special power goes out of control and hurts my neighbors? That would be all my fault!
Poffy frantically bites her fingernails, then steels herself and suddenly lowers her voice, a mischievous grin spreading across her face.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Once she's starved past a certain point, the big bad Poffy will go rogue! Whether it's cupcakes or people, they'll all become my food!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: What's even more terrifying is that I don't simply become insane. I also lose all memory of what's happened during an outburst!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: My first Mania outburst happened while we were recording a program. I chewed on a crew member's arm on the set, which not only interrupted the shooting but also almost brought on a huge publicity crisis.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Though Mom paid a lot of money to scrub the videos and comments back then, if you dig deep enough, you should still be able to find some posts from that time.
Poffy swallows hard, her eyes darting around her backpack filled with snacks.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: The second time was when I was in high school. My hunger triggered a food explosion at school! It hurt my classmates and almost got the school into a scandal...

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Mom pleaded with everyone and paid a huge sum to keep the press quiet, so we managed to cover that incident up... Otherwise, I would've been arrested long ago.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: You may not understand just from hearing about it. But seeing is believing, I can give you a demonstration!
Hearing no objection from you, Poffy rummages in her bag and pulls out a bag of corn kernels, pinching one between her fingers.
With a loud pop, the corn kernel explodes suddenly, turning into a piece of popcorn.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: See? I made the kernel pop with my bare hand! And that's just 10%... no, 1% of my power! See how lethal I am as a Sinner?

Seeing your silence, she grabs another handful of corn kernels. With a series of pops and crackles, the kernels quickly expand, and fluffy white popcorn spills from her palm as the aroma fills the entire interrogation room.
She frees up her other hand to grab yours, shoving all the popcorn into your palm.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: And mind you, I'm not even starving right now, yet I can already make food explode instantly. During a Mania outburst, my ability will truly scare you!
You hold the still-warm popcorn that continues to crackle softly, pick up a piece, and pop it into your mouth.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A human microwave, huh...

You can indeed sense the Mania stirring more and more vigorously within her. Perhaps it's because she hasn't reached that level of hunger yet, or maybe your presence is suppressing the Mania within her, but for now she still appears to be perfectly lucid and normal.
Grrr... Her stomach rumbles loudly in the interrogation room. Poffy looks at you with pleading eyes and swallows hard.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Um... Chief, look, the popcorn's all ready. Can't we share? I'm really so hungry...
You sigh and pour the popcorn back into Poffy's hands.
Poffy lets out a small cheer, then starts crunching away happily, her face glowing with pure bliss.
Amid the gentle crunching sounds, Poffy's mood quickly settles, and the Mania energy in the interrogation room gradually stabilizes as well.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Your file is missing some crucial information! None of the major incidents I caused are even in there. You should investigate more thoroughly!

You gently tap Poffy's file. As she said, the information in this file is incomplete. Apart from including Poffy's past family situation and child star experience, it indeed makes no mention of the two incidents she spoke of.

If it's really as Poffy said, that her mother played the role of protector in those incidents, it's possible they were never reported to the Bureau. You plan to assign someone to investigate more thoroughly once the interrogation is finished.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll arrange for someone to look into them. But I hope the understanding is mutual, Miss Poffy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Currently, the incidents you've caused don't meet the severity threshold for detention, but given that you've requested to be detained... if you're really facing some difficulties, the Bureau will find a way to help you.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Really?
Poffy's eyes flicker, seeming truly swayed by your words. She unconsciously reaches toward her backpack, but the moment her fingers touch the zipper, she pulls back and looks at you anxiously.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: ...Will you really help me?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you tell the truth.
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: Anyway, whatever it takes, you must stay in the Bureau. Don't let them kick you out!
(End of Flashback)
Just when you think Poffy would lower her guard and spill the truth, she suddenly buckles at the knees and collapses to the floor, even positioning herself toward the camera.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Boohoo... you're all so mean! You think I eat too much, so you want to kick me out!

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: But I've been helping out too! I cooked lots and lots of delicious rice, and everyone praised me! What's a couple extra bites...? Just let me stay! I'll do anything. I can even wash dishes!
Not expecting this turn of events, you rub your temples in exasperation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...You should be cooperating with the investigation, not applying for a job at the cafeteria. We're not understaffed.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: This is Sinner abuse! I'm going to file a complaint! I demand arbitration! I demand legal intervention! This violates the Sinner protection law!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is there such a law? Which provision does it violate?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: I, I don't know... Anyway, you can't just bully me like this! This is wrong! Boohoo...

As you said, the number of Sinners you've encountered indeed exceeds Poffy's age in years, but you've barely met any with such a childish temperament who would throw tantrums when losing an argument like Poffy.

You feel ridiculous as you watch the girl crying on the floor, but you're beginning to understand something. This little foodie is probably hiding some other secrets, but for some reason, she can't divulge them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, get up... You'll remain detained.

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: For real? Can I get extra portions for dinner then? I've been in here for so long, I'm starving!
Poffy's expression immediately brightens, and she nimbly scrambles up from the ground.

Utterly speechless now, you scoff. This girl hasn't stopped snacking throughout the entire interrogation, and now she's still going on about being hungry. You finally understand how the cafeteria storage got cleaned out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Fine, you can have my chicken drumstick. Happy now?

steps.speaker: Poffy
steps.content: Oh my gosh! Chief, you're so good to me! I knew you were a nice person!
Poffy patters out of the interrogation room. Your ears can finally have some peace.
You let out a deep sigh and gather up the snack wrappers Poffy has left behind, shoving them all into the trash can.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Well, it's just one more mouth to feed. Shouldn't be a problem... The investigation needs to continue anyway. Temporary detention isn't unwise.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But before the investigation is complete, I hope the Bureau's food budget can hold up... Should I apply for additional funding in advance?
[Scene Change]
The next day, Nightingale places a letter on your office desk.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The staff pulled an all-nighter conducting a detailed investigation into Poffy's background. The report will be updated soon. This letter was found in the mailbox at her front door. It hasn't been opened yet.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It seems she was too eager to seek refuge with the Bureau and forgot to check her mailbox before leaving.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That should be the case.
Nightingale reports on some other tasks and soon leaves.
Sitting at your office desk, you stare at the pristine letter with one line written on it: <color=#fb9259>To Miss Poffy</color>.

Perhaps this letter can answer your questions: Why does Poffy so desperately want to stay at the Bureau, even at the cost of losing her freedom? And why does she worry so much about the potential impact of her special power?
